name: What factors influence the rate of roof weathering in the DFW area?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the rate of roof weathering in the DFW area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the DFW area, several factors accelerate roof weathering. Intense summer heat and prolonged UV exposure cause materials to become brittle and lose protective granules. Frequent temperature fluctuations between seasons lead to expansion and contraction, stressing roofing components. High winds and sporadic hail events, even minor ones, can also contribute to accelerated wear over time. Understanding these local conditions helps homeowners anticipate and plan for necessary assessments and maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: DFW's intense heat, UV exposure, temperature fluctuations, and high winds accelerate roof weathering, causing materials to degrade faster.
